% Discrete cell-centered divergence
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A5_divB}
(\nabla\cdot\mathbf{B})_{i,j} = \frac{B_x^{i+1/2,j} - B_x^{i-1/2,j}}{\Delta x} + \frac{B_y^{i,j+1/2} - B_y^{i,j-1/2}}{\Delta y}
\end{equation}

% CT face update (Evans-Hawley 1988 Eq.\ 17)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A5_update}
B_x^{i\pm 1/2,j,n+1} = B_x^{i\pm 1/2,j,n} - \frac{\Delta t}{\Delta y}(E_z^{i\pm 1/2,j+1/2} - E_z^{i\pm 1/2,j-1/2})
\end{equation}

% Telescoping identity
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A5_telescoping}
\Delta t\,\Delta x\,\Delta y\,\left[(\nabla\cdot\mathbf{B})^{n+1} - (\nabla\cdot\mathbf{B})^n\right] = 0
\end{equation}

% GS05 averaging 2nd-order accuracy
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A5_GS05}
E_z^{\text{avg,corner}} - E_z(\text{corner}) = \tfrac{h^2}{8}(\partial_x^2 E_z + \partial_y^2 E_z) + \mathcal{O}(h^4)
\end{equation}
